headline: Binance Flips To A 73.7 Million Dollar Intake As Exchange Inflow Climbs To 547.7 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, is a 547.7 million dollar net inflow, 0.2022 percent of custodied value, compared with a 296.8 million dollar net inflow at 0.1095 percent on the prior print. Binance showed a 73.7 million dollar inflow, compared with a 168.7 million dollar outflow in the previous report, while Bitstamp took in 294.3 million dollars and Bybit took in 127.3 million dollars, up from 74.0 million in that report. Bitfinex showed a 103.6 million dollar outflow, compared with 109.8 million dollars in the previous report, and a positive net means dollars arrived where holders can sell while a negative print means dollars left that venue.
author: jordan
